## 🐛 Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 📋 Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include screenshots or error logs if applicable.

## 📸 Screenshots / Recordings

If applicable, add screenshots or recordings to help explain the problem.

**Drag images here or use markdown:**
```
![Bug screenshot](paste-image-link-here)
```

## 🌍 Environment

- **OS:** [e.g., macOS 14, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04]
- **Browser:** [e.g., Chrome 120, Firefox 121, Safari 17]
- **Browser version:** [e.g., 120.0.6099.130]
- **Node.js version:** [run `node -v`]
- **npm/pnpm version:** [run `npm -v` or `pnpm -v`]
- **App version:** [check `package.json`]

## 🔐 User Context

- **User role:** [Student / Admin / Anonymous]
- **Browser language:** [e.g., bn-BD, en-US]
- **Device:** [Desktop / Mobile / Tablet]
- **Connection:** [WiFi / 4G / 3G / Slow]

## 📊 Additional Context

- **Frequency:** [Always / Sometimes / Once]
- **First seen:** [When did you first notice this?]
- **Related issues:** [Link any related issues]
- **Workaround:** [Any temporary fix you found]

## 🎯 Impact

- [ ] **Critical** (blocks core functionality, affects all users)
- [ ] **High** (blocks important feature, affects many users)
- [ ] **Medium** (degraded experience, workaround exists)
- [ ] **Low** (minor inconvenience, edge case)

## ✅ What I've Tried

- [ ] Cleared browser cache
- [ ] Tried in incognito/private mode
- [ ] Tried different browser
- [ ] Checked browser console for errors
- [ ] Searched existing issues

## 📎 Additional Information

Add any other context, logs, or screenshots about the problem here.
